❓ How It Works

1. Choose Your Game

Play Solo, Family Game Night or the Daily Puzzle.

2. Select a Tile

Reveal a scrambled word from the B-I-N-G-O board.

3. Unscramble & Submit

Solve the word. Use progressive hints when needed.

4. Make BINGO!

Keep solving until you reach the selected winning goal.

🎮 Built for More Ways to Play

SOLO PLAY

Challenge yourself, improve your score and enjoy up to 3 free regular games each day.

FAMILY GAME NIGHT

Add players, take turns, use Covered or Open boards and enjoy friendly competition.

DAILY PUZZLE

A separate free community challenge with the same puzzle for everyone that day.

PROGRESSIVE HINTS

Five hints become progressively more helpful. Each hint used reduces the score.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family Game Night — How to Play

👥
Add 2 or More PlayersGreat for families, friends, classrooms and groups. The current player's name appears on screen.
⏱️
Take TurnsSelect a tile. A hidden 45-second timer begins automatically when the tile opens.
🔤
Unscramble the WordType the answer and submit it. Ask for a progressive hint if needed.
✅
Correct AnswerThe tile stays solved and the game advances to the next player.
❌
Wrong Answer or Time-OutThe tile is covered again, the turn ends and the next player's name appears.
⭐
Covered or Open BoardCovered adds suspense; Open lets everyone see all scrambled words. FREE stays visible, and Faith appears on every board.
